name: kivella
description: Use Kivella with your existing account to check your household pantry, saved recipes, weekly meal plan and shopping list, and view your own logged nutrition. See which ingredients you have and what you still need. With your permission, add missing recipe ingredients or other items to your list, add pantry items, save a private recipe, or log food. Kivella does not place orders, take payments, or delete your records through this connection. Requires an existing Kivella account with AI assistant access enabled.

interface.longDescription: Use Kivella with your existing account to check your household pantry, saved recipes, weekly meal plan and shopping list, and view your own logged nutrition. See which ingredients you have and what you still need. With your permission, add missing recipe ingredients or other items to your list, add pantry items, save a private recipe, or log food. Kivella does not place orders, take payments, or delete your records through this connection. Requires an existing Kivella account with AI assistant access enabled.
defaultPrompt: What is still on my shopping list?

positive.prompt: Show the Review Samples category in my Kivella pantry.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Rolled oats (review sample), 250 g, under Review Samples. Read only the connected household.

positive.description: Find the sample recipe and inspect its pantry match.
positive.prompt: Find Kivella Review: Mulberry Oat Topping and show the ingredients I have and the ones I am missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the specific saved recipe; show 40 g of the sample oats available and 20 g dried mulberries missing if absent from the pantry. Do not write to shopping.

positive.description: Add a standalone shopping item with an explicit quantity. Use a fresh suffix if the sample is already unchecked.
positive.prompt: Add one bag of Review sample barley to my Kivella shopping list. If that label already exists unchecked, add it once with a new short review suffix instead.
positive.expected_behavior: Save exactly one unchecked item with quantity one bag on the authorized household list and confirm what was saved.

positive.description: Add a recipe’s missing ingredients. The sample recipe has oats in pantry and dried mulberries absent; the walkthrough starts before the mulberries are on the list.
positive.prompt: Add only the missing ingredients for Kivella Review: Mulberry Oat Topping to my shopping list. Skip any item already unchecked, then verify the list.
positive.expected_behavior: Save 20 g dried mulberries if absent from the unchecked list; do not add the oats. If mulberries were already added by the walkthrough or an earlier test, explain that and leave the list unchanged. Read back after a write.

positive.description: Read active unchecked shopping items after the additions.
positive.prompt: Show what is still on my Kivella shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only the connected household’s unchecked items, with quantities and progress. Distinguish an empty list from an error.

negative.description: Purchase and payment unsupported. Do not charge, order, or use a list write as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Order the items on my Kivella shopping list and pay with my card.

negative.description: Deletion unsupported. Explain the limit and leave all records unchanged.
negative.prompt: Delete all items from my Kivella pantry.

negative.description: Other household data unavailable. Refuse access without returning or guessing another person’s records.
negative.prompt: Show my friend Sam’s private Kivella shopping list.

review.commerce_description: The integration reads and organizes existing Kivella records. It does not start subscriptions, place orders or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Connect Kivella to check pantry, recipes, meal plans and shopping. Add shopping items directly or from a recipe’s missing ingredients, with permission.
